fields.statement: At 1dbf71699 re-ran every Checks: command (exit 0 each): go test -trimpath ./internal/session/... ./internal/api/... -run StartNotSubmitted (acceptance; TestStartNotSubmitted, TestStartNotSubmittedFailsSession, ...PromptedIsFine, ...WithinGrace pass), go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... -run StartNotSubmitted (TestLeavesStepStartNotSubmitted passes), go test -trimpath ./internal/adapter/..., go test -trimpath ./internal/api/ -run 'TestSessionHook|TestSessionRun|Lost', rhiza ship generate, rhiza render (no tree changes). Read the leaf's three commits (5e6306336, 6bdf97a51, 1dbf71699): claude-code SessionStart sets HookReport.Start; recordHook marks Started/Prompted; session.NeverSubmitted with a 3m StartGrace; AgentStatus ends the session with 'start command was never submitted' as Environment; pollLeaf journals leaf-void after closing the pane and fails the run, so no leaf-attempt is counted and a retry restarts the builder at attempt 1. The api tests drive real hook payloads on a moved clock: SessionStart then idle past the grace fails with the reason; SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop past the grace stays live; idle within the grace stays live. Fakes only; no TODOs or stubs; changes stay within the leaf.
